chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: Personnel and tunes on the Kid Ory record, and the program's date
summary: Willard lists Mutt Carey, Ory, Dink Johnson, Fred Washington, Ed Garland and Ben Borders; the sides included Ory's Creole Trombone and Society Blues.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I found the list of people on that Kid Ory record: Mutt Carey, cornet; Kid Ory, trombone; Dink Johnson, clarinet; Fred Washington, piano...
Yeah, that's what I told you.
Ed Garland, bass, and Ben Borders, drums. That's right, huh?
And Ory's Creole Trombone--they list that as
the name of one of the numbers. Right?
Yeah, that's one of the numbers.
And "Society Blues" on the other side.
"Society Blues," yeah, was our number, and the ones that the girl sang--"Crooked Blues" and uh..."That Sweet Something Dear," I think, and I don't know what else.

It says September the 15th, a Thursday. I don't know. I think it was about '47 is what I think. '46 or '47. It was right after Austin come back from the war, and that was, I think, '45 or somethin' like that, and [End of reel].
